```lean
Filter.atBot.{u_3} {α : Type u_3} [Preorder α] : Filter α
```
***
`atBot` is the filter representing the limit `→ -∞` on an ordered set.
It is generated by the collection of down-sets `{b | b ≤ a}`.
(The preorder need not have a bottom element for this to be well defined,
and indeed is trivial when a bottom element exists.) 
***
*import Mathlib.Order.Filter.AtTopBot*

```lean
nhds.{u_3} {X : Type u_3} [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) : Filter X
```
***
A set is called a neighborhood of `x` if it contains an open set around `x`. The set of all
neighborhoods of `x` forms a filter, the neighborhood filter at `x`, is here defined as the
infimum over the principal filters of all open sets containing `x`.

```lean
ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) : StieltjesFunction
```
***
Cumulative distribution function of a real measure. The definition currently makes sense only
for probability measures. In that case, it satisfies `cdf μ x = (μ (Iic x)).toReal` (see
`ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_toReal`).
